summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, the non-US equivalent of a US Form 8-K) dated November 3, 2026, enclosing a press release announcing a capital increase in its wholly-owned subsidiary Turkcell Teknoloji Arastirma ve Gelistirme A.S. The subsidiary's capital was raised by TRY 13,996,300,000 to TRY 14,000,000,000, with the parent's pre-emption rights fully paid in cash. No board recommendation, advisor, ownership split, regulatory clock, or securities offering terms are stated. This is an internal subsidiary capitalization, not a special situation; watch for downstream uses of the injected capital.
